rule: w_acc = 0.5 * L_traj(B_s0) / L_acc(B_s0), both evaluated with B's s0 checkpoint on the training windows of HBLEND's fit set
L_traj_definition: w_traj * (ade / 3 + 0.5 * fde / 6): the trainer's own trajectory contribution (R1); mean over the fit windows
L_acc_definition: v8f_mini.accel_term at unit weight on the same windows (R2)

alt_readings_not_used.note: R1 is declared before any OACC number; the ADE-only reading is shown so the choice is visible, and decides nothing
